document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You can scarcely believe your eyes! Worm-like things are 
beginning to curl around your feet! Almost instantly you perceive 
that these few weak gropers are only the scouts for a mass of 
crawling flesh grasping for food. 
The worms are animals making natural attacks—your ring, if 
you have this item, has no power against them. Make a successful 
Dodge roll to get away. Fail, and make a STR roll (add a bonus 
die if you have a knife): succeed, and you get away; fail, and 
you must roll again but now with one penalty die—the mass of 
worms grows and begin to hold you fast. If you fail this roll, you 
have one more chance, but you have two penalty dice on your 
roll! If you succeed at any roll, you break free and return to 391. 
If you’ve failed three times to break free you are doomed and 
consumed by the worms. For you, it is... THE END.
(368)
